BiblicalUsage: Jehoiachin is a Jewish king, the son of Jehoiakim, carried to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar. In 2 Kings 24:6, Jehoiakim slept with his fathers. The fuller story is told on the Jehoiachin, King of Judah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jehoiachin matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
